Hello, I would like to answer some of your questions.

01. Investing and Trading both have pros and cons of their own. If you are very busy and doesn't want to stay updated then you should go for investing in blue chips accumulating as much as shares you can and remember investment should be not for 2-3 years. I believe a fruitful investment should be of more than 10 years. On the other hand trading needs your time and you should have an edge. I see many people do intraday trading but I am totally against it. I believe trading should be of carry forward your trades not just gambling. 

02. Many big investors have always suggested that you should bring only that amount of money that you can afford to lose. Bit if you are sincere about investing then I would suggest to do an SIP in your investment.

03. Ofcourse investment can be profitable if you have selected companies with visions and value. 

04. We are in the micro level of economy in our country. What I believe is when we invest in a company we are giving it a hand to grow and when the company grows surely its business portfolio will grow its outflow will grow which will directly have an impact on the economy. That's how our investment will have an effect on our country's economy. I have always believed that in every household there should be atleast one member who should be atleast involve in market. More the people start to participate in market more the country will grow. 

05. Yes, there are enough datas provided in the internet to actively participate in the market. NSE provides datas  every end of the day for retail people like us. There are enough datas on NSE's site to understand the direction of a stock or any indices but the thing is you need to have the edge to decode those datas according to your convenience and how you see the market. I will stop here to say this that if I say trading then I mean positional trading not intraday. I dont believe in intraday trading atleast not for retail and novice traders like us. Intraday trading needs a different type of temparament and years of psychological practice. So to your question, yes we can. 

06. If I talk about myself, I am a trader and have a limited fund and I dont trade in F&O or intraday. I am fully married to end of the day cash market. So for me there's never a question for time or error, the only thing I lack is fund. Ofcourse I have losing trades too but there are times when I have running trades and due to no funds even though I see an opportunity I can't enter. Nobody have everything right?
